description:
Creates a public event pinned to a location for the signed-in user; everyone can see it immediately.
startAt must be before endAt and endAt must be in the future, both ISO-8601 UTC instants.
Hashtags are written inline in the message as #tag. To attach images, first call get_publishing_media_keys and pass the returned keys as medias.
Returns the new event's id, geoHash and public url. Events share the post velocity limit: 5 per 10 minutes and 50 per day.

endAt.description: Event end, ISO-8601 UTC instant after startAt and in the future. Example: 2026-10-30T12:00:00Z.

latitude.description: Latitude of the event location, between -90 and 90. Example: 48.8566.

longitude.description: Longitude of the event location, between -180 and 180. Example: 2.3522.

medias.description: Media keys from get_publishing_media_keys, at most 7.

message.description: Text of the event, at most 6000 characters, #hashtags inline.

startAt.description: Event start, ISO-8601 UTC instant. Example: 2026-10-30T10:00:00Z.

name: create_event

id.description: Id of the new post; pass it with geoHash to get_post or create_comment.

url.description: Public page of the new post or event.

title: Create event
